result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would eliminate **scarcity as a root cause of suffering**—ensuring that every human being has guaranteed access to their fundamental needs: clean water, nutritious food, healthcare, shelter, and quality education. 

While this sounds material, the ripple effects would be profound. So much of the world's conflict, anxiety, prejudice, and cruelty stem from the fear of not having enough—whether that fear is real or manufactured. 

When people no longer have to fight for sheer survival, the collective energy of humanity could shift from defense to creation. We would unlock an unprecedented amount of human potential, as millions of brilliant minds currently bogged down by poverty and hardship would suddenly be free to innovate, art, heal, and explore.
